name: kioku-ui
description: A public, product-neutral React design system.

scripts.check: pnpm check:repo && pnpm check:package-boundaries && pnpm lint && pnpm build:packages && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.examples:build: pnpm --dir apps/example-vite install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/example-vite build && pnpm --dir apps/example-nextjs install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/example-nextjs build && pnpm --dir apps/example-vite-source install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/example-vite-source build && pnpm --dir apps/example-nextjs-source install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/example-nextjs-source build
scripts.release:verify: pnpm pack:smoke && pnpm check && pnpm format && pnpm a11y:audit && pnpm build && pnpm verify-exports && pnpm examples:build
